documents.text:
SupplyHub

SupplyHub operates a two-sided B2B marketplace connecting industrial equipment manufacturers with small and mid-size manufacturing facilities. The platform handles quoting, procurement, and logistics for MRO supplies across North America. Marketplace take rate is 12% on transactions. Currently facilitating $180M in GMV annually with 2,400 supplier listings and 8,500 active buyer accounts. Revenue of $21.6M with unit economics showing LTV/CAC of 4.2x. Raised $30M Series A. Founded in 2020, team of 65 based in Chicago.
